scope.network: Playwright intercepted HTTPS requests for wending-artifact.test and returned local fixture responses. Requests to other hosts were aborted.
diagnostic_limitations: A deterministic local provider fixture was used; these results do not establish production provider availability or production response correctness.
The cloud-browser export failure was not reproduced locally.
The native picker observation does not demonstrate either a successful save or a rejected picker call.

environment.exception_capture: CDP Debugger.setPauseOnExceptions with state=all, including caught and uncaught exceptions; additional pageerror and download observers where applicable.

procedure: Create an isolated browser context for the source-module variant and serve the existing index.html and source files through local HTTPS interception.
Click the title-screen new-journey action, enter 林照, and click the live birth confirmation.
Return the same valid deterministic opening scene from the local mock capabilities/session/turn endpoints.
Read the displayed UI and native IndexedDB runs/pending stores, and capture all exceptions and page errors.
Repeat the same single opening in a fresh isolated context using the exact existing offline HTML bytes served over HTTPS.

opening_comparison.conclusion: Both variants completed the local-mock live opening with the same phase, revision, turnId, pending count, choices, and visible scene. No custom-bundler runtime difference or opening failure was reproduced in this fixture.

native_picker_single_attempt.setup: A fresh isolated browser context completed a valid live opening for 林照, then opened 游戏设置 and clicked 导出完整存档 once.
native_picker_single_attempt.conclusion: The native picker call remained pending during the 10-second observation; no error, success message, or download was observed. The temporary browser context was then closed. The cloud-browser 导出未完成 failure was not reproduced locally, and no cloud failure type or stack can be inferred from this result.

compatibility_assessment.basis: Read-only inspection of src/app.js exportLiveGame, observed at lines 929-942; no fix was implemented in this diagnostic.
compatibility_assessment.current_behavior: The export path checks whether showSaveFilePicker exists. Any non-AbortError from the picker/export block reaches the generic export-failure notification.
compatibility_assessment.minimal_compatible_change: If opening showSaveFilePicker rejects because the picker is unavailable in the browser environment, fall back to the existing Blob download before acquiring a file handle. An AbortError should return without downloading.
boundaries: Do not automatically download merely because the picker is still waiting for user selection.
Do not silently convert archive read/validation failures or downstream writable/pipeTo failures into a second download attempt.
This assessment does not identify the actual cloud-browser error type; none was reproduced locally.

provenance.original_scripts: Executed as ephemeral node --input-type=module heredocs; no standalone diagnostic script files were saved.
provenance.raw_result_evidence: The observed API calls, state/UI values, exception arrays, picker capability values, and timeout result are embedded above; external transient scripts or tool sessions are not the sole evidence.
